# SpikingMoE_SDPrompt

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking mixture-of-experts architecture that uses SDPrompt-guided dynamic expert fusion to route spikes to specialized subnetworks based on input context. Enables adaptive, energy-efficient computation in neuromorphic systems by dynamically activating only relevant expert pathways, reducing spiking activity and improving task-specific performance.
